Catalog row case-index 1.0.0: the inventory of cases the site serves (data/derived/manifests/index.json). The contract is at version 1.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-pipeline/pipeline/core/manifest.py}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/contracts/schemas/common/case-index.schema.json}; the committed documents it governs are data/derived/manifests/index.json. The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/contracts/test\_documents.py::test\_index\_validates}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{frontend/src/lib/contract.test.ts}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: missing: copy-data stops the site build (no site without an inventory); at run time getJSON throws ArtifactError (an HTTP status or a non-JSON answer); a view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, and the C04 result sections show a LoadError alert (data-state error), never an empty chart. stale: engine\_version differs from VERSION (the index records the engine that baked it). Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:data/derived/manifests/index.json. The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/contracts/test\_documents.py::test\_every\_document\_matches\_exactly\_one\_schema\_and\_validates}.

\subsubsection{\texttt{regulatory-calculators}: Regulatory calculators}
\label{sec:contract-regulatory-calculators}

The official worked examples (the five CRE99 SA-CCR netting sets from their trades, the RBC20.13 output floor) and the invariant cases (BA-CVA, the FRTB SBM aggregation with its cross-bucket fallback, the liquidity-horizon cascade) of the regulatory calculators run through the engine, the output-floor phase-in, the parameter tables and a CRE20 lookup grid, each with its paragraph and in-force date. The live ports of the regulation page are held to this document at 1e-9 relative. The contract is at version 1.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-pipeline/pipeline/regulatory/}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/contracts/schemas/regulatory/calculators.schema.json}; the committed documents it governs are data/derived/regulatory/*.json. The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/regulatory/test\_calculators.py::test\_the\_committed\_document\_validates\_and\_the\_checker\_is\_clean}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_every\_regulatory\_entry\_has\_a\_paragraph\_and\_an\_in\_force\_date\_and\_the\_schema\_refuses\_one\_without}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_the\_five\_cre99\_netting\_sets\_carry\_the\_published\_eads\_the\_printed\_intermediates\_and\_their\_trades}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_the\_trade\_level\_cre99\_path\_rounds\_exactly\_to\_the\_five\_published\_eads}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_the\_output\_floor\_examples\_are\_101\_5\_and\_95}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_the\_invariant\_cases\_hold\_and\_an\_official\_example\_has\_a\_published\_value\_and\_an\_invariant\_has\_none}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_the\_cre20\_grid\_equals\_the\_dossier\_tables}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_the\_regulatory\_checker\_refuses\_a\_wrong\_ead\_a\_wrong\_floor\_and\_a\_wrong\_multiplier}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_fixes.py::test\_every\_planted\_regulatory\_defect\_is\_refused}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}. \subsubsection{\texttt{governance-inventory}: Governance inventory}
\label{sec:contract-governance-inventory}

Catalog row governance-inventory 1.0.0: the model inventory of Contraste's own case models (data/derived/governance/inventory.json): one entry per fit (case\_id/fit\_id) with the 40 B.2 attributes, the components, the scope record, the tier block, the lifecycle state, the schedule dates, the dependency edges, the engine node and the governance findings of the inventory itself. The contract is at version 1.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{U15-S (producer U15-P in data-pipeline/pipeline/governance/, with tests/governance/; consumer U15-W in frontend/src/pages/experiments/)}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/contracts/schemas/governance/governance-inventory.schema.json}; the committed documents it governs are data/derived/governance/inventory.json. The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/governance/test\_governance\_documents.py::test\_every\_document\_validates\_against\_its\_schema}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{tests/contracts\_u15/test\_u15\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: the governance inventory is absent (data/derived/governance/inventory.json); copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws ArtifactError; the views show their Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, never an empty map. An attribute without a source is missing or not-applicable with its reason, never invented; a case document that is absent leaves its entry out with the reason in the excluded list. The cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot state (the tier is the matrix of its scores, an acyclic graph, the schedule dates) are tests/contracts\_u15/semantics.py violations(doc), which the bake runs over every document it writes. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/contracts/fixtures/governance/inventory-fixture.json. The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/contracts\_u15/test\_u15\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}.

\subsubsection{\texttt{governance-findings}: Governance findings register}
\label{sec:contract-governance-findings}

Catalog row governance-findings 1.0.0: the findings register across cases (data/derived/governance/findings.json): one row per case\_id/variant\_id/id with the product severity and its ECB F equivalent, the mapped B.7 status, the evidence, the anchor, the owner role, the raised and due dates, the ageing, the overdue flag, the remediation and the risk acceptance, with the counts. The contract is at version 1.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{U15-S (producer U15-P in data-pipeline/pipeline/governance/, with tests/governance/; consumer U15-W in frontend/src/pages/experiments/)}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/contracts/schemas/governance/governance-findings.schema.json}; the committed documents it governs are data/derived/governance/findings.json. The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/governance/test\_governance\_documents.py::test\_every\_document\_validates\_against\_its\_schema}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{tests/contracts\_u15/test\_u15\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: the findings register is absent (data/derived/governance/findings.json); copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws ArtifactError; the register view and the Findings-group opinion show their Pending state, never an empty table. An anchor without a cited test row is null with its reason, and a remediation is null with its reason (no remediation plan exists); a case document that is absent leaves its findings out. A case that holds no findings (C12 and C21 on 2026-10-20, R6) contributes no row. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/contracts/fixtures/governance/findings-fixture.json. The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/contracts\_u15/test\_u15\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}.

When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: missing: the engine release the product pins lacks a function of this contract; the bake fails with ImportError at its first call and publishes nothing, the governance documents stay absent (no partial document). A gov. test that cannot run returns a not\_evaluated row with its reason, never a number; a refused cycle, an unknown entry or a repeated component key raises ValueError and the bake publishes nothing. The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/test\_model\_slot.py::test\_swap\_baseline\_and\_fitted\_rungs}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{tests/test\_readiness.py::test\_a\_rung\_missing\_from\_the\_models\_artifact\_is\_training\_on\_the\_baseline}. As a model input or output it is described as follows: in: the C01 feature matrix (a table with the columns and units of docs/cases/C01.md, one row per account); out: PD per row (number in (0, 1), a probability). When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: training: a C01 models artifact lacks the fitted record of a rung (or none exists), the benchmark rung P0 answers (provenance baseline) and the Benchmark page labels the metrics with the model that answered. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is baseline:data-pipeline/pipeline/model/benchmark.py. The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/test\_model\_slot.py::test\_swap\_baseline\_and\_fitted\_rungs}.

The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/c10/test\_c10\_documents.py::test\_every\_committed\_document\_validates\_passes\_the\_checks\_and\_is\_listed\_with\_its\_hash}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u7/test\_u7\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u7/test\_u7\_contracts.py::test\_the\_grid\_cells\_are\_consistent\_with\_their\_generator\_and\_the\_size\_cell\_sits\_at\_the\_null}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u7/test\_u7\_contracts.py::test\_a\_simulator\_document\_without\_its\_known\_correlation\_fails}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{tests/contracts\_u7/test\_u7\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: a C10 correlation-grid artifact is absent; copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws ArtifactError; the C10 view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, never an empty chart. The known correlation is a required field of the generator and of every cell; a cell never has an estimator row missing. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/contracts/fixtures/c10/variant-correlation-grid-fixture.json. The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/contracts\_u7/test\_u7\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}.

\texttt{tests/contracts\_u8/test\_u8\_contracts.py::test\_the\_exceedances\_the\_scores\_and\_the\_ftest\_inputs\_recompute\_from\_the\_realised\_series}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u8/test\_u8\_contracts.py::test\_the\_rolling\_250\_day\_count\_and\_the\_zone\_recompute\_at\_one\_percent\_and\_are\_null\_at\_2\_5}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u8/test\_u8\_contracts.py::test\_the\_kupiec\_and\_christoffersen\_rows\_recompute\_from\_the\_exceedance\_days}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u8/test\_u8\_contracts.py::test\_a\_back\_test\_that\_cannot\_run\_is\_a\_not\_evaluated\_row\_with\_its\_reason\_never\_a\_number}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u8/test\_u8\_contracts.py::test\_the\_diebold\_mariano\_rows\_recompute\_on\_the\_common\_sample}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u8/test\_u8\_contracts.py::test\_a\_document\_without\_its\_sign\_convention\_fails}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u8/test\_u8\_fixes.py::test\_f2\_the\_fx\_2008\_window\_dated\_2008\_is\_refused\_and\_a\_correct\_window\_id\_date\_pair\_is\_accepted}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u8/test\_u8\_fixes.py::test\_f3\_a\_window\_under\_250\_days\_with\_an\_evaluated\_traffic\_light\_is\_refused}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u8/test\_u8\_fixes.py::test\_d3\_a\_window\_of\_250\_days\_or\_more\_with\_a\_not\_evaluated\_traffic\_light\_is\_refused}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u8/test\_u8\_fixes.py::test\_f8\_a\_contradicting\_document\_is\_refused}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{tests/contracts\_u8/test\_u8\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: a C11 window artifact is absent; copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws ArtifactError; the C11 view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, never an empty chart. A value the bake may lack is nullable with its reason in the document, never a number (an ES undefined on a day is null and listed in es\_undefined\_days; a model that forecasts no ES has a null FZ0 with its reason; a back-test that cannot run is a not\_evaluated row with its reason; the rolling 250-day traffic light of a window shorter than 250 days is not\_evaluated; the realised series of a window with a derived-only component is withheld with its reason). A day missing from a public series is skipped and counted in data\_status.missing\_days, never filled; the sign convention is a required field. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/contracts/fixtures/c11/variant-window-fixture.json. The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/contracts\_u8/test\_u8\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}.

\subsection{Case C12}
\label{sec:contracts-c12}

\subsubsection{\texttt{c12-outputs}: C12 variant (swap exposure, CVA and SA-CCR)}
\label{sec:contract-c12-outputs}

One variant of case C12 (swap exposure, CVA and SA-CCR): the six SDD variants share this schema and are told apart by outputs.variant. Every object is closed and nothing is optional; a block a variant does not run is null. The contract is at version 2.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-pipeline/pipeline/cases/c12/}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/contracts/schemas/c12/variant-swap-exposure.schema.json}; the committed documents it governs are data/derived/C12/*.json, !data/derived/C12/models-hw1f-treasury-2000-2025.json. The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/c12/test\_c12\_documents.py::test\_every\_committed\_document\_validates\_passes\_the\_checks\_and\_is\_listed\_with\_its\_hash}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_each\_variant\_carries\_exactly\_the\_blocks\_it\_runs}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_a\_planted\_defect\_is\_refused\_by\_the\_schema\_or\_the\_checker}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_every\_named\_parameter\_is\_required\_with\_its\_value\_and\_the\_convention\_label}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_the\_semantic\_checker\_is\_clean\_on\_every\_committed\_c12\_and\_regulatory\_document}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_the\_sa\_ccr\_ead\_recomputes\_from\_the\_trade\_inputs}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_eepe\_is\_at\_most\_the\_maximum\_of\_ee\_and\_the\_netted\_ee\_at\_most\_the\_sum}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_a\_money\_block\_without\_its\_currency\_fails}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_the\_backtest\_block\_has\_the\_horizons\_the\_dates\_and\_the\_sub\_windows}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_fixes.py::test\_every\_accepted\_plant\_of\_the\_review\_is\_refused}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{frontend/src/lib/contract.test.ts}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: a C12 variant artifact is absent; copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws ArtifactError; the C12 view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, never an empty chart. A Treasury tenor absent on the curve date is listed in curve.tenors\_absent with the tenors present, never interpolated silently; the ORE reconciliation is status reconciled for every variant but the wrong-way one (ORE reconciles the single swap, the netting set, both CSA variants and the initial-margin variant, S2) and not-applicable with its reason for the wrong-way variant only (ORE's example is a different model); an ORE run that fails stops the bake, the variant is not written and is never published as not-applicable; a calibration whose sample window ends on or after its backtest date fails; the IM block is a regression proxy and never SIMM. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/contracts/fixtures/c12/variant-swap-exposure-single-swap-fixture.json.

\subsubsection{\texttt{c12-models}: C12 models (HW1F calibration per backtest date)}
\label{sec:contract-c12-models}

The C12 models document: the Hull-White one-factor calibration per backtest date with its sample window, the counterparty curve, the transcribed GIRR parameters and the stated limits. The contract is at version 2.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-pipeline/pipeline/cases/c12/}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/contracts/schemas/c12/models.schema.json}; the committed documents it governs are data/derived/C12/models-hw1f-treasury-2000-2025.json. The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/c12/test\_c12\_documents.py::test\_every\_committed\_document\_validates\_passes\_the\_checks\_and\_is\_listed\_with\_its\_hash}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_a\_planted\_defect\_of\_the\_models\_document\_is\_refused}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_fixes.py::test\_the\_models\_document\_refuses\_a\_short\_window\_and\_too\_few\_observations}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_the\_models\_calibration\_of\_each\_date\_ends\_before\_that\_date\_and\_has\_three\_years}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u9/test\_u9\_contracts.py::test\_the\_models\_girr\_parameters\_are\_the\_transcribed\_r7\_values}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{frontend/src/lib/contract.test.ts}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: the C12 models artifact is absent; loadCase throws ArtifactError for every C12 variant; the Model views show their Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there. A calibration date lacking three years of history before it is not written (the bake refuses), never a guessed parameter; a negative HQM-minus-Treasury spread is set to zero and counted, never carried; the counterparty curve is labelled a proxy and the Treasury-side licence sentence is stated UNVERIFIED. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/contracts/fixtures/c12/models-fixture.json.

The contract is at version 1.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/c15/test\_c15\_documents.py::test\_the\_six\_variants\_and\_the\_models\_document\_validate\_pass\_the\_checks\_and\_are\_listed\_with\_their\_hash}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u10/test\_u10\_contracts.py::test\_c15\_the\_models\_carry\_the\_annex1\_table\_the\_floors\_and\_the\_thresholds\_as\_transcribed}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u10/test\_u10\_contracts.py::test\_the\_semantic\_checker\_is\_clean\_on\_every\_committed\_c14\_and\_c15\_document}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u10/test\_u10\_contracts.py::test\_a\_planted\_defect\_is\_refused\_by\_the\_schema\_or\_the\_checker}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{tests/contracts\_u10/test\_u10\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}. \texttt{tests/contracts\_u11/test\_u11\_contracts.py::test\_a\_planted\_defect\_is\_refused\_by\_the\_schema\_or\_the\_checker}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u11/test\_u11\_contracts.py::test\_the\_semantic\_checker\_is\_clean\_on\_every\_committed\_c16\_document}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u11/test\_u11\_fixes.py::test\_m1\_a\_non\_operational\_nfc\_segment\_run\_at\_a\_rate\_that\_is\_not\_the\_list\_table\_3\_3\_rate\_is\_refused}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u11/test\_u11\_fixes.py::test\_m2\_every\_lcr\_outflow\_rate\_at\_0\_01\_is\_refused}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u11/test\_u11\_fixes.py::test\_m3\_a\_cbc\_class\_haircut\_that\_is\_not\_its\_framework\_row\_is\_refused}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u11/test\_u11\_fixes.py::test\_m3\_the\_htm\_variant\_cannot\_publish\_the\_amortised\_cbc}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u11/test\_u11\_fixes.py::test\_m4\_a\_time\_block\_survival\_day\_beyond\_the\_horizon\_is\_refused}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u11/test\_u11\_fixes.py::test\_m5\_a\_series\_that\_is\_not\_ordered\_as\_its\_grid\_is\_refused}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{tests/contracts\_u11/test\_u11\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/contracts/fixtures/c16/variant-scenario-list-adverse-fixture.json. \label{sec:contract-c17-outputs}

Catalog row c17-outputs 1.0.0: one tail index of the operational risk case (outputs.kind tail-index), LDA against SMA on a generator of operational loss histories with a known true annual loss distribution. The contract is at version 5.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-pipeline/pipeline/cases/c17/}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/contracts/schemas/c17/variant-tail-index.schema.json}; the committed documents it governs are data/derived/C17/xi-*.json. The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/c17/test\_c17\_s3\_robust.py::test\_the\_committed\_documents\_carry\_the\_new\_rungs\_in\_every\_cell\_and\_the\_finding\_with\_its\_verdict}, \texttt{tests/c17/test\_c17\_documents.py::test\_every\_committed\_document\_validates\_passes\_the\_semantic\_gate\_and\_is\_listed\_with\_its\_hash}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u12/test\_u12\_contracts.py::test\_a\_document\_without\_its\_true\_parameters\_or\_true\_quantile\_fails}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u12/test\_u12\_contracts.py::test\_the\_calibration\_targets\_carry\_their\_source\_the\_derived\_only\_label\_and\_the\_transcribed\_values}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u12/test\_u12\_contracts.py::test\_a\_mean\_corrected\_sla\_for\_a\_tail\_index\_of\_one\_or\_more\_fails}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u12/test\_u12\_contracts.py::test\_an\_ilm\_is\_unreachable\_on\_fewer\_than\_five\_years\_in\_any\_c17\_block}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u12/test\_u12\_contracts.py::test\_percentile\_summaries\_are\_ordered\_and\_the\_ratios\_are\_capital\_over\_the\_true\_quantile}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u12/test\_u12\_contracts.py::test\_the\_aggregate\_exceedance\_curve\_agrees\_across\_methods\_and\_ends\_at\_the\_marked\_quantiles}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u12/test\_u12\_contracts.py::test\_the\_sma\_response\_curve\_applies\_the\_ope25\_formulas}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u12/test\_u12\_review\_fixes.py::test\_semantic\_the\_cell\_ids\_the\_seed\_ranges\_and\_the\_bank\_identities}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{tests/contracts\_u12/test\_u12\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: a C17 tail-index artifact is absent; copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws ArtifactError; the C17 view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, never an empty chart. A value the bake may lack is null with its reason, never a number: the true mean and the mean-corrected single loss approximation when the tail index is 1 or more (infinite\_mean true), a rung not evaluated for a cell (the scenario combination), an ILM on under 5 years of loss data never exists (a C17 cell is 5 or 10 years; the engine gives BIC only with its reason, OPE25.15); the cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot state are \texttt{semantic\_findings} in tests/contracts\_u12/c17\_semantic.py, which the bake (U12-P) runs over every document it writes; the synthetic label (truth\_status synthetic-known-truth, the truth block with the generator's true parameters and the true 99.9 percent annual loss quantile) is part of every document. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/contracts/fixtures/c17/variant-tail-index-fixture.json. The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/contracts\_u12/test\_u12\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}.

\subsubsection{\texttt{c18-outputs-reverse}: C18 reverse stress variant}
\label{sec:contract-c18-outputs-reverse}

Catalog row c18-outputs-reverse 1.0.0: the reverse stress variant (outputs.kind reverse), the minimum Mahalanobis distance scenario that takes CET1 to the Chilean legal minimum stack. The contract is at version 1.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-pipeline/pipeline/cases/c18/}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/contracts/schemas/c18/variant-reverse.schema.json}; the committed documents it governs are data/derived/C18/reverse-stress.json. The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/c18/test\_c18\_documents.py::test\_every\_committed\_document\_validates\_and\_the\_set\_agrees}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u13/test\_u13\_contracts.py::test\_the\_reverse\_document\_has\_the\_failure\_point\_the\_scenario\_its\_distance\_plausibility\_and\_loss}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u13/test\_u13\_contracts.py::test\_a\_satellite\_window\_that\_reaches\_2020\_or\_later\_fails}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u13/test\_u13\_contracts.py::test\_a\_planted\_defect\_is\_refused\_by\_the\_layer\_the\_table\_names}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{tests/contracts\_u13/test\_u13\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: the C18 reverse-stress artifact is absent; copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws ArtifactError; the view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, never an empty chart. A failure point the factor space cannot reach (no start converges, or the loss at the solution misses the threshold beyond the tolerance) is refused by the checker with its reason and written as no document, never as a number. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/contracts/fixtures/c18/variant-reverse-fixture.json. The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/contracts\_u13/test\_u13\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}.

\subsection{Case C21}

\subsubsection{\texttt{c21-outputs}: C21 year-pair variant}
\label{sec:contract-c21-outputs}

Catalog row c21-outputs 2.0.0: one HMDA year pair, fitted on year t and confirmed on t+1 (outputs.kind year-pair). No legal claim. The contract is at version 3.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-pipeline/pipeline/cases/c21/}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/contracts/schemas/c21/variant-year-pair.schema.json}; the committed documents it governs are data/derived/C21/pair-*.json. The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/c21/test\_c21\_documents.py::test\_every\_committed\_document\_validates\_passes\_the\_checks\_and\_is\_listed\_with\_its\_hash}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u14/test\_u14\_contracts.py::test\_a\_c21\_document\_without\_the\_no\_legal\_claim\_label\_fails}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u14/test\_u14\_contracts.py::test\_the\_four\_fifths\_flag\_is\_labelled\_an\_employment\_benchmark\_and\_follows\_the\_counts}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u14/test\_u14\_contracts.py::test\_a\_c21\_document\_with\_an\_outcome\_conditioned\_test\_fails}, \texttt{tests/contracts\_u14/test\_u14\_contracts.py::test\_hmda\_field\_names\_come\_from\_the\_research\_addendum\_only}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{frontend/src/lib/contract.test.ts}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: a year pair whose HMDA data is absent has no document and is never a fixture; a field HMDA withholds or bins is a nullable value with its reason (data\_notes); an estimate that cannot be computed is null with its reason. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:docs/contracts/fixtures/c21/variant-year-pair-fixture.json. The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/contracts\_u14/test\_u14\_contracts.py::test\_the\_fixture\_exists\_and\_is\_discovered\_by\_exactly\_one\_schema}.

\subsection{Case C22}
\label{sec:contracts-c22}

\subsubsection{\texttt{c22-variant}: C22 validator variant}
\label{sec:contract-c22-variant}

Catalog row c22-variant 3.0.0: one validation harness run (outputs.kind validator). The test ids, the families (variants) and the panels are closed enums; the simulations of the engine's named studies carry a study block, every other simulation a null one. The contract is at version 3.0.0 and its status in the catalog is \emph{real}. Its producer is \texttt{data-pipeline/pipeline/cases/c22\_validator.py}, and its schema file is \texttt{docs/contracts/schemas/c22/variant.schema.json}; the committed documents it governs are data/derived/C22/*.json, !data/derived/C22/models-generators.json. The producer side is tested by \texttt{tests/contracts/test\_documents.py::test\_variants\_validate}, \texttt{tests/test\_c22\_all\_families.py::test\_the\_schema\_refuses\_an\_unknown\_test\_id\_family\_and\_study}, \texttt{tests/c22\_sequential/test\_sequential\_c22.py::test\_the\_committed\_block\_is\_the\_run\_of\_2000\_series\_per\_scenario\_on\_the\_engine\_1\_1\_0}, and the consumer side, the web application that reads the document, by \texttt{frontend/src/lib/contract.test.ts}. When the data is missing or out of date the behaviour is fixed in advance: partial: an artifact a manifest names is absent; copy-data stops the site build, and at run time getJSON throws ArtifactError (an HTTP status or a non-JSON answer); a view shows its Pending state (data-state loading) while the data is not there, and the C04 result sections show a LoadError alert (data-state error), never an empty chart. The other variants and cases keep working. Its provider, the document served before and besides the real one, is fixture:data/derived/C22/null.json. The test that every document matches exactly one schema is \texttt{tests/contracts/test\_documents.py::test\_every\_document\_matches\_exactly\_one\_schema\_and\_validates}.
